name: Night Fjord
theme: A covert Nordic shoreline raider who moves through moonless fjords, uses tide noise and deep shadow for concealment, disables maritime defenses, and delivers precise attacks before disappearing into the dark.
visualIdentity: Deep navy and charcoal raider leathers, twin Fjordshadow Seax Knives, muted iron fittings, coastal infiltration gear, sea-weathered accessories, and restrained silver-gray fog and shadow effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, raider silhouette, knife design, gear arrangement, muted iron fittings, and navy, charcoal, steel, sea-fog blue, and dark iron palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Tide Shadow
starterAbilities.description: Blend into shoreline terrain and moving shadows to avoid detection.

starterAbilities.name: Moonless Strike
starterAbilities.description: Launch a devastating attack from darkness before the target can react.

starterAbilities.name: Undertow Snare
starterAbilities.description: Create hazardous terrain and movement restrictions using hidden traps.
